description: With DDL at two levels, a failed DDL statement, an inner commit and an outer Rollback, what catalog survives, and do the COUNTER values used by rolled-back inserts come back? BeginTrans; CREATE TABLE X (ID LONG primary key); INSERT INTO C (PID, W) VALUES (1, 'outer'); BeginTrans; ALTER TABLE T ADD COLUMN Z LONG; CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG) (fails, the name exists); DBEngine.Errors; CommitTrans; Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; catalog; INSERT INTO C (PID, W) VALUES (2, 'after') outside any transaction; read C; close; catalog and C through a fresh Workspace. All statements use dbFailOnError.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
